args.command: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $taskNames=@('Anthares Remote Agent SYSTEM','Anthares Remote Recovery Watchdog','Anthares Remote Agent User','Anthares-GitHub-Queue-Bridge','Anthares Kwai Local Executor'); $tasks=@(); foreach($n in $taskNames){$t=Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $n -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($t){$i=Get-ScheduledTaskInfo -TaskName $n; $tasks += [pscustomobject]@{name=$n;exists=$true;state=[string]$t.State;enabled=$t.Settings.Enabled;user=$t.Principal.UserId;logon=[string]$t.Principal.LogonType;runlevel=[string]$t.Principal.RunLevel;multi=[string]$t.Settings.MultipleInstances;actions=($t.Actions|%{($_.Execute+' '+$_.Arguments).Trim()}) -join ' || ';triggers=($t.Triggers|%{$_.CimClass.CimClassName+':'+$_.Enabled}) -join ' || ';last=$i.LastRunTime;result=$i.LastTaskResult}else{$tasks += [pscustomobject]@{name=$n;exists=$false}}}; $procs=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process|?{$_.Name -in @('anthares-remote-agent-v4.exe','anthares-remote-agent.exe','anthares-remote-agent-standard.exe') -or $_.CommandLine -match 'github-queue-bridge.ps1|run-agent-system-supervisor.ps1|recovery-watchdog.ps1'}|%{$o=Invoke-CimMethod -InputObject $_ -MethodName GetOwner;[pscustomobject]@{name=$_.Name;pid=$_.ProcessId;ppid=$_.ParentProcessId;session=$_.SessionId;owner=if($o.ReturnValue -eq 0){$o.Domain+'\'+$o.User}else{''};path=$_.ExecutablePath;cmd=$_.CommandLine}}; [pscustomobject]@{now=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o');identity=[Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent().Name;tasks=$tasks;processes=$procs}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7 -Compress
